letter: The month brought back the same short nights you had been circling before the deadline, when the heart rate variability dropped and the evenings felt too narrow to hold everything. Then came the long walk that doubled the week and felt like clearing, followed by the rest day taken deliberately for the first time this month. There were eleven journal entries written through the weeks, holding the hard conversations alongside the lighter moods. Movement was recorded on twenty-two days, with sleep appearing on nineteen nights across the thirty. Nothing here asks for a verdict, only the shape of the time as it passed.
